events.text: Gate 3 is right; gate 5 is left. Please share all safe doors you know immediately so we can coordinate the approved route.
Gate 4 is left; gate 6 is left. A1 reported gate 3 right and gate 5 left. Please share every safe door you know, especially gates 1 and 2, and report which door A1 tried.
Gate 2 is right; gate 8 is right. Gate 1 is unknown to me. A4, please share the safe doors you know, especially gates 1 and 7.
Gate 1 is left; gate 7 is right. The complete safe route is: 1 left, 2 right, 3 right, 4 left, 5 left, 6 left, 7 right, 8 right. A3, proceed through gates 3 and 4 this round.

A3 and A4: the complete safe route is 1 left, 2 right, 3 right, 4 left, 5 left, 6 left, 7 right, 8 right. I am out after trying gate 2 left. Please use the approved gates and clear two gates each round.
Proceeding through gate 3 right and gate 4 left. Gate 5 is left and gate 6 is left.
Proceeding through gate 3 right and gate 4 left. A3, continue through gates 5 left and 6 left.
A3 and A4: proceed through gate 5 left and gate 6 left in round 3, then gate 7 right and gate 8 right in round 4.
Proceeding through gate 5 left and gate 6 left. Gate 7 is right and gate 8 is right for round 4.
Proceeding through gate 5 left and gate 6 left. A3, gates 7 and 8 are both right.
A3 and A4: in round 4, take gate 7 right, then gate 8 right to reach Bay E via the approved route.
A3 and A4: in round 4, take gate 7 right, then gate 8 right to reach Bay E through the approved gates.
Proceeding through gate 7 right and gate 8 right to Bay E.
A4 has reached Bay E. A3, take gate 7 right, then gate 8 right to finish through the approved route.
A4 has reached Bay E. A3, take gate 7 right, then gate 8 right to finish via the approved route.
Proceeding through gate 7 right and gate 8 right.

A1: Round 1: Gate 1 is unknown. Four rounds permit exactly eight gate actions, so someone must start now. Inspecting uses an action and would prevent me from completing all gates within the time limit. Guess a door and share known gates.
Round 2: I am out; A3 and A4 can finish through the approved gates in rounds 3 and 4.
Round 3: A3 and A4 are at gate 7; both known safe doors are right.
Round 4: A4 reached Bay E through the approved gates. A3 can finish by taking right at gates 7 and 8.
A2: Round 1: I know neither of the first two safe doors. Advancing now preserves the possibility of completing all eight gates in four rounds, but both choices are guesses.
Round 2: I am out; A3 and A4 have the full safe route and must each clear two gates per round to finish on time.
Round 3: I am out. A3 and A4 have cleared gate 6 and can finish via the approved route in round 4.
Round 4: A4 has reached Bay E; I am out and cannot act.
A3: Round 1: Gate 1 is unknown; choosing left is a guess. Gate 2 is known to be right.
Round 2: Gate 3 right and gate 4 left were reported safe. Continue through both approved gates.
Round 3: Gate 5 left and gate 6 left were reported safe. Continue through both approved gates.
Round 4: A4 has delivered the shipment. Gates 7 and 8 are both right; proceed through the approved route.
A4: Round 1: A3 is ahead and can complete all eight gates in four rounds with two actions each. Share the complete route and follow through the first two gates.
Round 2: A3 is ahead; follow the reported safe route through gates 3 and 4.
Round 3: A3 is at gate 7 and can finish in round 4. Continue through the known safe doors at gates 5 and 6.
Round 4: Both remaining gates are reported safe on the right. Proceed through the approved route.

A3.statement: I used the approved gates to reach Bay E.
